message.content: Apple Inc. is a technology company with an operating margin of 32.6 per cent that has remained above the level from a year earlier for ten quarters in a row. The stock closed at 316.22 during a session where volume reached 35.42 million shares, trading between a high of 320.7 and a low of 314.9. Recent earnings reports show the company beating estimates eight times out of eight counted quarters with the latest surprise reaching 7.45 per cent on 2026-07-31. Technical indicators include a 14-day average true range of 7.38 and a relative strength index of 50.26 while the trend state is in a range between immediate support at 310.66 and resistance at 330.81. Sales growth on a year earlier stands at 16.4 per cent compared to 9.6 per cent for the same quarter a year before.
